examples.arabic: جلسنا معا لساعة نتبادل الاخبار ونتحدث عن ذكرياتنا الجميلة
examples.english: We sat together for an hour to exchange news and talk about our beautiful memories
examples.transliteration: Jalasna ma'an li-sa'a natabadal al-akhbar wa nathadath an dhikrayatina al-jamila

examples.arabic: أوه، لقد نسيت تماماً بسبب انشغالي بالأخبار العاجلة، دعنا إذن نؤدي صلاتنا أولاً ثم نطلب طعامنا اللذيذ.
examples.english: Oh, I completely forgot due to my busyness with the breaking news, let us then perform our prayer first then order our delicious food.
examples.transliteration: Oh, laqad nasitu tamaman bisabab inshighali bil-akhbar al-'ajila, da'na idhan nu'addi salatana awwalan thumma natlub ta'amana al-ladhidh.
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.arabic: اما السيد احمد فكان يفضل شرب قهوته بهدوء وقراءة الاخبار
examples.english: As for Mr. Ahmed, he preferred to drink his coffee calmly and read the news.
examples.transliteration: Amma al-sayyid Ahmad fakan yufaddil shurb qahwatih bihudu' wa qira'at al-akhbar

examples.arabic: في المساء كان الجد يشاهد الاخبار على التلفاز
examples.english: In the evening, the grandfather was watching the news on television.
examples.transliteration: Fi al-masa' kana al-jadd yushahid al-akhbar ala al-tilfaz.

examples.arabic: كثير منهم كانوا يجتمعون لصلة الرحم وتبادل الاخبار مع العائلة والاصدقاء
examples.english: Many of them were gathering to maintain family bonds and exchange news with family and friends.
examples.transliteration: Katheer minhum kanu yajtami'un li-ṣilat ar-raḥim wa tabadul al-akhbar ma'al-'ailah wal-asdiqa'.

examples.english: We talked about family news and work.
